title: France Deploys Military Assets to Saudi Arabia, Revealing Discreet Defense Cooperation
detail: France has deployed military assets to Saudi Arabia, bringing previously discreet Paris-Riyadh defense cooperation into the open. The deployment signals a deepening of bilateral defense ties between France and the Gulf kingdom.

media.caption: France deploys military assets to Saudi Arabia

title: Pope Leo XIV Celebrates Mass at Stade de France, Denounces Violence and Oppression
detail: Pope Leo XIV celebrated mass at the Stade de France during his apostolic visit to Paris, delivering a message against violence and oppression. The pontiff called on the faithful to fight for their faith without resorting to weapons of violence, contempt, or oppression.

media.caption: Pope Leo XIV celebrates mass at Stade de France

title: Pope Leo XIV Celebrates Open-Air Mass for Hundreds of Thousands on the Champs-Élysées
detail: Pope Leo XIV presided over a solemn open-air Mass at Place de la Concorde and along the Champs-Élysées, with nearly 600,000 people registered to attend as part of an estimated one million visitors drawn to Paris for his four-day France visit. The Mass, secured by roughly 14,000 police, gendarmes and soldiers alongside 2,500 firefighters, coincided with a nationwide 'climate, living things, peace and social justice' mobilization drawing hundreds of organizations across France.

media.caption: Preparations for Pope Leo XIV's open-air Mass on the Champs-Élysées and Place de la Concorde.
